notes.title: Online Multiplayer has arrived! Plus a special gift: the World Champions Cup!
notes.content:
[h3]MULTIPLAYER IS HERE[/h3]
Without a doubt, the most requested feature is now a reality!
[b]Thank you to everyone who supported us by testing the beta and sending us feedback :)[/b]

Now you can enjoy friendly matches online, offering two different ways to interact with other players:
1) Matchmaking: Search and play against any available player looking for a game.
2) Friend Invites: Directly challenge a friend on Steam to a match.

In the main menu, select the 'Casual Online' option. This screen presents several options:
[list]
[*] [b]Find Opponent:[/b] This option matches you with another player looking for a game, facilitating an online match.
[*] [b]Invite Friend:[/b] Use this to invite a friend from your Steam friends list to play. Once you select a friend and send the invitation, they can join the game by accepting it.
[*] [b]Team Selection:[/b] Before starting a match search, choose your team here.
[*] [b]Sides and Controller Settings:[/b] These familiar options allow you to specify which side of the court you'll play on and adjust your control settings and preferences.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750750/4b3e2016c15b6326567d57bf75fe973a1594f96d.png[/img]
[h3]WORLD CHAMPIONS CUP![/h3]
We want to reward everyone who helps us grow our player base by seeking matches online, and to that end, we've created the World Champions Cup as a way of thanking you!  
A very special trophy, contested by national teams from countries that have been world champions. Representing each country will be the latest team to achieve this feat, with their original lineup.
In addition, for this tournament, we've also created a new stadium and a variant of the Global Cup... and of course, a new achievement for those who manage to win it!
We hope you like the idea as much as we do :)

[h3]MORE[/h3]
- We've rebalanced the teams in the D league of Career Mode to make it more accessible.
- We've also adjusted "Test Team" to reduce its aggressiveness in marking.
- Finally, we have fixed small bugs and minor details.


In this new stage, we need everyone's contribution to increase the user base and enhance matchmaking possibilities... It`s time to challenge your friends!

Thank you for joining us on this journey! We hope you enjoy this new adventure as much as we enjoyed creating it :)

notes.title: CHARRUA SOCCER - Mirror Edition - OUT NOW! and FREE for everyone!
notes.content:
Finally, today we are launching the game!!!
Thanks to all those who provided feedback during the early access stage. Thanks to your contributions, the game has improved and is now ready to be released :)
And it's [b]free for everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787814/e901669cb5944a1492ae4669440331010b886194.png[/img]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[b]Casual Matches[/b]
- We have separated casual matches, creating an area for them. Here you can invite your friends to play friendly matches, being able to configure the conditions of each match to your liking.
- And most importantly, for these matches each player can choose their preferred team, whether it be a national team or a club, you will have available the formation and potential of the chosen club!
- But also, now for every new friend you play a friendly match with, you will earn 1000 gold coins to use in the store! Get a unique ball, an original stadium, or whatever you like!

[b]Ranked Matches[/b]
This is where you shine with your team and where the real competition lies, and we have made several improvements.
- Matchmaking for ranked matches is now prioritized to find opponents at your own level, and if none are found, it expands that range until an opponent is found. We have now added the option to only limit the search to opponents within your range, if you prefer not to play and wait, to play with someone outside your range.
- We have created a leaderboard that highlights those in the top positions and informs you of your position.
- We have added more information to the end-of-match summary, so you can also see the coins earned and the evolution of your MMR, which will determine the league you should play in.
- We have improved the end-of-match screen for ranked matches so you can see not only the XP earned in that match, but also
- We have adjusted the balance of the ranked leagues to make the matches more competitive.
- And for all those who play a ranked match during [b]this first week of launch, you will earn 1000 gold coins[/b] to customize your team in the store to your liking!

[b]Also![/b]
- We have improved the information at the start and end of the match, to give more clarity to the fact that there are 2 simultaneous matches and highlighting the results on both teams.
- We have increased the frequency with which you receive information from the remote match.
- At the end of a half, when you have to wait for the remote match to finish, you can now know which minute of the game is being played.
- Finally, we have fixed small bugs and minor details.


In this new stage, we need everyone's contribution to increase the user base and enhance matchmaking possibilities... As a reward, there are tons of gold coins waiting for you! :)

Thank you for joining us on this journey! We hope you enjoy this new adventure as much as we enjoyed creating it... and now its time to challenge your friends or dive into ranked competitions!

notes.title: Special Invitation: Online Multiplayer Beta 2!
notes.content:
[h2]Everyone is invited to try online multiplayer matches in the beta![/h2]

[h3]HOW-TO DOWNLOAD:[/h3]
[list][*] Right click the game on your Steam Library.
[*] Click on "Properties".
[*] Select the "Betas" option from the list.
[*] Select the "onlinebeta" branch from the drop-down menu, if not selected already.
[/list]

(If you are not seeing the "onlinebeta" branch listed, you may need to restart the Steam client first)

[h3]WHAT’S NEW[/h3]
This beta version now allows you to enjoy friendly matches online, offering two distinct modes for engaging with other players:

1) Matchmaking: Search for and play against any available player looking for a game.
2) Friend Invites: Directly challenge a friend on Steam to a match.

In the main menu, select the 'Casual Online' option. This screen presents several choices:

[list]
[*] [b]Find Opponent:[/b] This option matches you with another player seeking a game, facilitating an online match.
[*] [b]Invite Friend:[/b] Use this to invite a friend from your Steam friends list to play. Once you select a friend and send the invitation, they can join the game by accepting it.
[*] [b]Team Selection:[/b] Before initiating a match search, choose your team here.
[*] [b]Sides and Controller Settings:[/b] These familiar options allow you to specify which side of the court you'll play on and adjust your control settings and preferences.
[/list]

[h3]HOW TO GIVE FEEDBACK[/h3]
We're eager to enhance your online gaming experience and value your input greatly. To facilitate this, you'll be prompted with an option to complete a brief survey after each match. We kindly encourage you to spare a few moments to share your feedback through this form. Your insights are incredibly important for us to refine and improve the game.

Additionally, you're more than welcome to reach out to us through various channels. Feel free to email us at support@batovi.com, message us on our social media platforms, or join the conversation with our community on Discord:

notes.title: New Update! - Asian Cup
notes.content:

- New tournament added, Asian Cup 2023-2024

[list]

[*] Fixed achievement for penalty goals not counting when the penalty goal was because of foul
[*] Fixed bug causing the music to stop playing during Tutorial match banners

[*] Fixed bugs caused by substitutions during an offside call

[*] Fixed bugs caused by players becoming stuck while taking/saving penalties
[*] Fixed a bug with the power bar during a throw-in performed with the Pass button
[/list]
[h3] LOCALIZATION: [/h3]

notes.title: New Update! - AI Improvements & New Languages
notes.content:
[h3]AI Adjustments and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Multiple adjustments to AI decisions when in possession of the ball.
[*]Improvements to player behavior during attacks.
[*]Multiple adjustments to AI behavior when defending.
[*]Improved AI decision-making when taking a corner kick.
[*]Improved AI decision-making when taking a free kick.
[*]Improved marking and tackling decisions.
[*]Improved AI decision-making when it comes to heading the ball.
[*]Improved reaction time of AI players to go towards the ball.
[*]Detection of an open goal when the opponent goalkeeper is knocked down, to shoot at it.
[*]Reduced chances of bad players shooting from far away from the goal when there are available passes.
[*]Changes in player attitude when their team loses or recovers the ball.
[*]Improved use of skills by the AI.
[/list]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New languages: Japanese, Korean (and improvements in Simplified Chinese)
[*] Option to enable/disable offsides.
[*] Indicator of the player committing the offside.
[*] Special headers, by holding down the shoot button, the player heads the ball downwards or upwards, depending on the attacking or clearing situation respectively.
[/list]

[h3]Goalkeeper[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjustment in the goalkeeper calculation when saving shots that bounce before reaching the goal.
[*]Adjustment of the power in the goalkeeper's volleys. Now, the AI should almost never make very soft volleys.
[*]Significant reduction in the chances of the goalkeeper running outside the area with the ball in hand.
[/list]

[h3]Various[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improvements in offside detection to avoid unclear offsides.
[*]Adjustment in offensive attitude to make it more balanced.
[*]Adjustment in the volume of the "Goal" shout.
[*]Adjustment in the scale of the names above the players.
[*]Adjustment in the accuracy of your player's shots.
[*]Cooldown addition for the "Block tackle" and "Front tackle" skills to prevent spamming.
[*]Adjustment in the conditions for jumping to head the ball or do a bicycle kick.
[*]Adjustment of marking and speed of your team's players in Hard mode.
[*]Delay in the formation of a corner after taking it.
[*]Adjustment in the probability of consecutive evasions.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where the formation image was not updating in the strategy menu after changing it (but it was still functional).
[*]Corrected erroneous goalkeeper state when the ambulance entered, causing the goalkeeper to be out of position.
[*]Prevented AI players from sliding into their own goal while charging a shot or pass.
[*]Fixed issue where goalkeeper would hold onto the ball indefinitely after saving a penalty.
[*]Corrected some male teams that had players with female heads
[/list]

notes.title: New Update! - Super Shots! Workshop!
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS: [/h1]

[h3] EXTENDED PROFILE FEATURES AND STEAM WORKSHOP INCLUDED[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented the Steam Workshop functionalities within the game.
[*] Implemented the Steam Badges, Trading Cards, Emoticons, and Backgrounds collectibles.
[/list]

[h3] GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS [/h3]

[*] Four different Super Shots. When a red star is on the player, press (SKILL) to shoot!
[*] Added a white star indicator for Sprinting.
[*] Added a yellow star indicator for the manual skills (overhead kick, dribble, scissor kick, etc.).
[*] Added new animations for the goalkeeper in matches and in penalty kicks.
[*] The goalkeeper kick has more height, to allow for more aerial battles.
[*] Improved goalkeeper position when there is a close opponent with the ball.
[*] Camera movement improvement to better follows the action.
[*] Change in controls: PCS Style and Tradicional style are more similar now.
[*] Added the option to control the direction of the Change Player action using the right stick/analog.
[*] Curved kick/Crossing Skill: The ball can be curved holding the left trigger while moving the directional control.
[*] Changing tactics or attitude is now performed with the D-pad/arrows in your joystick.
[*] Added a more realistic player-body collision with the ball.
[*] The match tutorial hint stays on the screen for some seconds.
[*] Super shot skill.
[*] Resolved a bug preventing the game from continuing in extremely rare situations.
[*] Improved the ball collision with poles.
[*] EuroChamps League.
[*] Matches are now 3 minutes by default.
[*] Particle effects improvements.
[*] Added a small movement on the ball on a throw-in.
[*] Audio improvements on collision with poles.
[*] Goalkeepers now don´t crouch to grab the ball if outside the area or very near the border.
[*] Bugfixes.

[*] Fixed the placement of some food carts on stadium backgrounds.
[*] Fixed the pairing of right parentheses and period on the PixelArt font used.
[*] The "Choose Difficulty" intro screen will now allow you to return from the Custom menu and select one of the pre-arranged profiles.
[*] Hall of Fame will display transparent cups or achievements for those you have not collected.
[*] Unified the Friendly Match icons.
[*] Unified the cups/trophies sizes.
[*] Fixed animations for the Team Overview screen.
[*] The career intro and board screen will now fade to black when finished.
[*] The slider will now cycle from the last button to the first and vice versa.
[*] Unified the order in which tournaments are displayed through different screens.
[*] Set the UI speed to level 2 by default.
[*] Unified language in many buttons throughout the game.
[*] Unified the timing for the board's laughs.
[*] Added tournament names at the Standings screen.
[*] Formations now display a generic icon and the formation name at the button. The description is displayed at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Ads in the field for important tournaments.
[*] Fixes in some animations.
[*] Tons of polishing details and bug fixes.

notes.title: Introducing Party Mode: couch Co-Op up to 4vs4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750750/cfa310d96fe3ec5773a6f6a784f00cc918dede1d.png[/img]
[h1]UPDATE HIGHLIGHT: [/h1]

[h3]CO-OP[/h3]
Co-op fully working. Play with up to 8 players locally or with remote play.
AI improvements to mark unmarked players (necessary for Co-op).
Selected human players obstruct each other.

[h3]PARTY MODE[/h3]
Play a tournament with your friends.

[h2]TECHNICAL RELEASE NOTES:[/h2]
[h3]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Offside rule! (necessary for Co-op). 
[*] Replay for offside.
[*] Kick forces are balanced (the players kick more powerful than before when charging).
[*] Minimum speed, rotation and acceleration increased for players with zero stats.
[*] Goalkeeper crouch and forward diving to get the ball from the opponent.
[*] Traditional style controls and PCS style controls help screens.
[*] Controllers settings can be accessed for the options, pre-match screen and in game.
[*] Controllers settings and gameplay options can be configured for each controller.
[*] Difficulty levels (easy / normal / hard).
[*] The game asks for difficulty and control style the first time it is run (can be changed in the settings).
[*] AI improvement to avoid players to stand still for a long time.
[*] AI improved when running with the ball and must kick to the goal (most advanced player).
[*] Balanced the marking / dribbling resolution when fighting for the ball.
[*] Goalkeeper AI can walk with the ball in hands before passing or kicking.
[*] The players with zero stats now have more control of the ball.
[*] Wind force reduced.
[/list]
[h3]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player size was increased a bit to improve readability of team colors. 
[*] Snow weather now looks better.
[*] Improved the visuals of the snow/rain/storm weathers.
[*] De-saturation of the field to help readability of team colors.
[*] [b]Australia & Wales included in the Global Cup.[/b]
[*] Changed the controls preview pre-match screen to display an image of one of the connected joysticks and its currently selected control setup and corresponding glyph.
[*] Added animations for camera-folk looking north.
[*] Added a button within joystick configuration that opens the [i]Steam controller config[/i] directly.
[*] Changed the random tournaments option to not be random by default. Instead tournaments will start with their predefined brackets and participants.
[*] Added a build number display at the Main Menu for easy identification of current release version, specially on gameplay videos you use to report bugs.
[*] Changed the in-game HUD to accommodate for Co-Op player indicators, names, stamina bar, etc...
[*] Changed colors code for the [i]Locked[/i] and [i]Unavailable[/i] icons at the skills menu.
[*] Implemented the Offside Law and immediate camera replay for offside.
[*] Implemented a choice to start your subsequent career slots without the [i]Situations[/i] mechanic. You can also disable the situations for an existing career save slot. [b]Beware that this cannot be re-activated once disabled.[/b]
[*] Changed the looks of the input text fields.
[/list]
[h3]BALANCE IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the initial career players skills: Now up to 9 players in your roster will start with a [i]Ball Control[/i] skill and there is a 70% chance that for all 30 players that they will also have one of the nine 0-stars skills.
[*] Implemented a new difficulty selection screen at game start. This gives you the choice for three presets that can tailor your game experience to match your expertise with soccer games.
[*] Front slide tackle foul/yellow cards balance (less chances of foul).
[*] Goalkeeper reaction time balance (more saves if kick from a far position).
[*] Fast kick (kick button tap) now kicks the ball high only in the defensive half of the pitch.
[/list]
[h3]BUG-FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Solved the kick off bug, preventing starting the game.[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the kick particle to remain visible.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some [i]Back[/i] buttons to return two menu levels back instead of one.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the speed of the texts at the [i]How To Play[/i] screens to change with the render frame rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Career Mode beta - Weekly Update
notes.content:
[b][i]As mentioned in our previous communication, we will continue to provide weekly updates as we are able to move forward with developing relevant new content. Please find below our remarks explaining what is changed in comparison to the previous update[/i][/b]


[h2]HOW-TO DOWNLOAD:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Right click the game on your Steam Library
[*] Click on "Properties"
[*] Select the "Betas" option from the list
[*] Select the "careermodebeta" branch from the drop-down menu
[/list][i](If you are not seeing the "careermodebeta" branch listed, you may need to restart the Steam client first)[/i]

[h2]DISCLAIMER:[/h2]
[list]
[*] As you'll see, there still are and there will be details to work on. We wanted to show you that we are working on delivering new features and improvements in a timely fashion
[*] The game is NOT balanced. We are still within a development process. It is being constantly improved and new features are being added every week
[*] The game will have BUGS. Please report them if you can afford the time
[/list]
[h2]TECHNICAL RELEASE NOTES:[/h2]
[h3]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Disallowed the kick off shot towards the opponents goal. Now kick off can only be directed to your side of the field
[*] Implemented a falling/missing shot animation for when the shot control is pressed for more than the allowed 1 second. This is also the case for passes, corner kick, throw-in, goal kick, kick off
[*] Balanced the power stat related to Pass/Kick
[*] Remapped controls for the Goalkeeper. Pass button is a One Handed Pass, Kick button is a Two Handed Pass and the Skill button performs a Half Volley shot
[*] Implemented the Power Kick to Goal type of shot. It can be performed by pressing the Pass/Kick button between 0.9 a 1.0 seconds. It is pending to be associated with the skills logic
[*] Added a field to display cost of XP spending
[*] Changed the Team Creation screen to save team details when pressing ESC key to avoid accidental deletion
[*] Added the light reflection and depth effect on the custom team round flag that is displayed on the scoring field
[*] Added some new pixel art pieces to the Events/Calendar screen that sghows previous and future matches
[*] Changed the CareerMode Icon
[*] Added the possibility to accelerate the UI elements so that transitions and animations are faster for people who want to try and speedrun through the game
[*] Changed the color and enlarged the highlight for Text Input fields
[*] Changed spacing for the Half-Time and End-Game statistic panels
[/list]
[h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the shot strength bar to stay stuck in screen
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the color effects used for snow climate to stay applied to the rest of the UI even after the match
[*] Fixed a community reported bug that caused the CPU players not to be assigned for Free Kick correctly when the user performed some roster substitutions
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the music to be played in its entirety when Enable/Disable music is toggled while in game
[*] Fixed a community reported bug that caused the CPU players not to be spending stamina when running with the ball. The stamina indicator at the player head is yet to be corrected however the stamina indicator at the bottom of the screen continues there for your information
[/list]

notes.title: Career Mode beta is now live!
notes.content:
[b][i]This is the first version of the new Career Mode. In this mode you can create your team and start playing in League D, playing the season and gaining player experience to improve players stats and skills[/i][/b]

[h2]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We are releasing this version as a "beta version"
[*] The idea of this release is to show you the development progress of the game, to give an idea of the future features and to show where the game is going to
[*] We need your feeedback to improve the game and make it the best retro soccer game possible!
[*] From now on, we will be updating this beta version weekly (usually on Fridays)
[/list]
[h2]HOW-TO DOWNLOAD:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Right click the game on your Steam Library
[*] Click on "Properties"
[*] Select the "Betas" option from the list
[*] Select the "careermodebeta" branch from the drop-down menu
[/list][i](If you are not seeing the "careermodebeta" branch listed, you may need to restart the Steam client first)[/i]

[h2]DISCLAIMER:[/h2]
[list]
[*] As you'll see, there still are and there will be details to work on. We wanted to show you that we are working on delivering new features and improvements in a timely fashion
[*] The game is NOT balanced. We are still within a development process. It is being constantly improved and new features are being added every week
[*] The game will have BUGS. Please report them if you can afford the time
[/list]

[list]
[*] Career Mode (work in progress)
[*] Team Editor
[*] Added three preset controller configurations:
 	[olist]
[*] WASD + JKL (pass/kick/skills)
[*] 	Arrows + BNM (pass/kick/skills)
[*]  	Arrows + ZXC (pass/kick/skills)
[/olist][*] Gameplay balance and improvements
[*] Tons of polishing details
[/list]
[h2]TECHNICAL RELEASE NOTES:[/h2]
[h3]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented a Kick/Pass power bar. (work in progress)
[*] Goalkeeper improvement (more bounces)
[*] Implemented an option that allows for tournaments to be created using random team groups or a preset format
[*] Implemented stun animations and logic
